verdict.rationale: Base44's core product is built around a built-in AI assistant: users describe tasks in natural language and the assistant builds/edits the app (docs-31, docs-33), while 'AI agents' and 'Superagents' inside apps can update records, trigger workflows, connect to external tools (Slack, GitHub, Notion), run scheduled workflows, take meeting notes, and browse the web autonomously (docs-6, docs-43, docs-45–48). Community hands-on reports corroborate that this in-app AI delegation produces fully functional results (comm-4, comm-5, comm-6). Missing for 10: independent benchmarking of task-delegation reliability/limits beyond anecdotal community praise.
